description: This file defines a class 'Root' that extends 'PPS' for creating and saving root PPS objects within OLE containers in a PHP spreadsheet library. It includes methods for constructing the root entry, saving the OLE container to a file, calculating sizes, and handling big and small data blocks.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root property set (PPS) for OLE containers, allowing creation, manipulation, and saving of the root entry in an OLE compound document structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Root class with timestamps and child PPS objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entire OLE container, writing header, data blocks, PPS structures, and directory listings to the specified file or stream.

methods.name: calcSize
methods.description: Calculates the sizes of small and big data blocks needed for the OLE container based on PPS data.

methods.name: adjust2
methods.description: Helper function for computing block sizes for the filesystem.

methods.name: saveHeader
methods.description: Writes the header information of the OLE container to the file stream.

methods.name: saveBigData
methods.description: Saves data from PPS objects that are too large for small blocks, handling big data blocks.

methods.name: makeSmallData
methods.description: Gathers small data blocks into a contiguous string and prepares the small block storage.

methods.name: savePps
methods.description: Saves the structure and WKs (write keys) for each PPS object.

methods.name: saveBbd
methods.description: Creates and writes the Big Block Depot, handling directory and BBD structures.
